parameters.name: e_value
parameters.label: Reporting E-value (-E)
parameters.help_text: Report sequences with E-value <= this in output. HMMER requires x > 0.

parameters.name: score_threshold
parameters.label: Reporting bit-score (-T)
parameters.help_text: Report sequences with bit-score >= this. HMMER will reject the run if combined with -E.

parameters.name: domE
parameters.label: Reporting domain E-value (--domE)
parameters.help_text: Report domains with E-value <= this. HMMER requires x > 0.

parameters.name: domT
parameters.label: Reporting domain bit-score (--domT)
parameters.help_text: Report domains with bit-score >= this. HMMER will reject the run if combined with --domE.

parameters.name: incE
parameters.label: Inclusion E-value (--incE)
parameters.help_text: Threshold for considering a sequence significant (used for downstream alignment output). Defaults to reporting -E.

parameters.name: incT
parameters.label: Inclusion bit-score (--incT)
parameters.help_text: Threshold for considering a sequence significant by bit-score. HMMER will reject the run if combined with --incE.

parameters.name: incdomE
parameters.label: Inclusion domain E-value (--incdomE)
parameters.help_text: Threshold for considering a domain significant.

parameters.name: incdomT
parameters.label: Inclusion domain bit-score (--incdomT)
parameters.help_text: Threshold for considering a domain significant by bit-score. HMMER will reject the run if combined with --incdomE.

parameters.name: max_filter_off
parameters.label: Disable all heuristic filters (--max)
parameters.help_text: Maximum sensitivity. Much slower; bypasses the filter pipeline. Disables --F1/--F2/--F3.

parameters.name: F1
parameters.label: Stage 1 MSV filter P-value (--F1)
parameters.help_text: Lower = stricter filter (faster but may miss hits). Default 0.02.

parameters.name: F2
parameters.label: Stage 2 Viterbi filter P-value (--F2)
parameters.help_text: Default 1e-3.

parameters.name: F3
parameters.label: Stage 3 Forward filter P-value (--F3)
parameters.help_text: Default 1e-5.

parameters.name: nonull2
parameters.label: Disable null2 score correction (--nonull2)
parameters.help_text: Turn off the second-stage biased-composition correction applied to per-domain scores.

parameters.name: Z
parameters.label: Effective database size for E-values (-Z)
parameters.help_text: Assume the database contains this many sequences when computing E-values. Use to keep E-values comparable between runs of different database sizes.

parameters.name: domZ
parameters.label: Effective # significant sequences for domain E-values (--domZ)
parameters.help_text: Fix the denominator used for per-domain E-value calculation.

parameters.name: noali
parameters.label: Suppress alignments in output (--noali)
parameters.help_text: Omit per-domain alignments from the main report (smaller files).

parameters.name: textw
parameters.label: Custom line width (--textw)
parameters.help_text: Maximum characters per line in the main text report.

parameters.name: tformat
parameters.label: Target sequence file format (--tformat)
parameters.help_text: Force target sequence file format instead of autodetecting.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.label: Random seed (--seed)
parameters.help_text: Use 0 for a non-deterministic, arbitrary seed.

parameters.name: cpu
parameters.label: Parallel CPU workers (--cpu)
parameters.help_text: Number of parallel worker threads. Server defaults to 2.
